title: Find blocks item effect outcome
description: Finds all blocks matching the given condition in the given bounding box and runs the given outcome for each of them, originating from the given position. Adds a 'ref' vector, an 'index' number and a 'successCount' number to the context for the outcome.

origin.$comment: The position that the search will originate from.

bounds.$comment: The bounding box to search within. Format: [ x1, y1, z1, x2, y2, z2 ]

condition.$comment: The given outcome will be run for all blocks that match this condition.

outcome.$comment: This outcome will be run for each block that matches the condition. A 'ref' vector (holds the position of the block), an 'index' number and a 'successCount' number will be added to the context for the outcome.
